core/utils/motion/scroll-spring.ts

Scroll-position chase spring — the shared driver both
Sourcesrc/core/utils/motion/scroll-spring.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

(module scope)

Live spring state for one track — extends the shared chase triple (currentP/velP/targetP in px) with loop bookkeeping. raf doubles as the running flag (0 = idle).

raf

Pending rAF id — 0 while the loop is stopped.

last

Timestamp (ms) of the previous tick — 0 marks the first frame.

elapsed

Wall-clock runtime (ms) for the MAX_MS watchdog.

onSettle

Fired once when the spring settles or is force-settled.

states

Per-track spring states — WeakMap so detached tracks never leak.

tickSpring

Runs one spring tick: integrates the px chase, writes the track's scrollLeft, and either re-arms or settles (snap to target + class lift + onSettle). Kept as a closure over (track, state) so the rAF body itself allocates nothing per frame.

  • @param track The scrolling element.
  • @param s The track's spring state.
  • @param animClass Class lifted on settle.
  • @param ts rAF timestamp (ms).

springScrollTo

Spring-scrolls track to target scrollLeft. Mid-flight retargets preserve velocity (the organic part — a rapid double-tap nav curves onto the new course instead of restarting). When a spring is already live only the target/onSettle update — the loop keeps its frame cadence.

  • @param track The scrolling element (the carousel track).
  • @param target Target scrollLeft (px).
  • @param animClass Track modifier class that disables CSS snap+smooth
  • @param onSettle Called once on settle — normal completion path for
  • @param instant Reduced-motion / no-animation escape: writes the

cancelSpringScroll

Cancels a live spring — user-input takeover (wheel/touch): the track stays wherever the spring left it and mandatory snap re-engages from the lifted class. The caller's onSettle is dropped — a cancelled nav must not fire its teleport.

  • @param track The scrolling element.
  • @param animClass The modifier class to lift.
